mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audio_render (composition_hash, composition_json) VALUES (#{hash}, #{json}) ON CONFLICT (composition_hash) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE audio_render SET status = 'PROCESSING', error_message = NULL WHERE composition_hash = #{hash} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE audio_render SET status = 'DONE', file_key = #{fileKey}, duration = #{duration} WHERE composition_hash = #{hash}
UPDATE audio_render SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE composition_hash = #{hash}
UPDATE audio_render SET status = 'PENDING', file_key = NULL, duration = NULL WHERE composition_hash = #{hash} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'DONE')
UPDATE audio_render SET status = 'PENDING' WHERE status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT composition_hash FROM audio_render WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at
